ev.q: Among case-patients, 20.3% were fully vaccinated, compared with 34.3% of controls
Reinfection was defined as receipt of positive NAAT or antigen test results during May 1–June 30, 2021.
Among case-patients, 20.3% were fully vaccinated, compared with 34.3% of controls
Using conditional logistic regression, ORs and CIs were used
In this case-control study, being unvaccinated was associated with 2.34 times the odds of reinfection

methods_quotes.q: Case-patients and controls were matched on a 1:2 ratio based on sex, age (within 3 years)
Using conditional logistic regression, ORs and CIs were used to compare no vaccination and partial vaccination with full vaccination
Random matching was performed to select controls when multiple possible controls were available to match per case
